messages:
Irene Ramos: Folks — finalizing the internal release note for tomorrow's rollout (UTC 22:00-23:30). Need quick signoff on blurb + model pin + rollback phrasing, and a request for @jo to post + pin in #general at 21:50 UTC. Draft below, pls comment with any must-change items.

Irene Ramos: Draft (please copy-edit):
```
Release: Redwood Inference platform v2.3.1 (inference runtime + routing updates)
Change window: 2025-03-15 22:00 — 2025-03-15 23:30 UTC
What: Deploy runtime improvements (attention optimization), model routing change to redwood-model/v2.3.1, and a config tweak to reduce cold-starts.
Impact: Short (0-2 min) connection blips expected for long-running sessions; canary starts at 20% for 15m. No schema changes.
Rollback: If customer-facing regressions occur, ops will pin traffic back to redwood-model/v2.2.9 and revert the runtime config within the change window.
Notes: Support has prepared canned responses; metrics dashboards & alerts are provisioned.
Link: https://go.redwood.ai/releases/v2.3.1
```

Deepak Patel: LGTM. One request: please explicitly pin the model version in the blurb (you already did) and call out the canary rollout percentages (20% -> 100%). Also add the canary playbook link.

Sam O'Neill: Ops here — change window OK. Canary plan: 20% for 15m, then 50% for 15m, then 100% if no errors. Preflight checklist done (infra, dashboards, rollback runbook). Will attach playbook: https://go.redwood.ai/playbooks/canary-deploy

Jo Kim: Comms — will shorten the public blurb for #general. For internal pinned post we should keep full notes + link to product changelog. I'll post at 21:50 UTC and pin both in #general + #releases. Can you add a 1-line customer-impact summary?

Ellie Torres: Support — add this to the canned responses: expected 1-2 min reconnect for sessions >10k tokens, and advise customers to retry. I'll paste replies in a follow-up.

Irene Ramos: Updated draft with model pin and canary percentages + added canary playbook. Pasted final internal blurb below. @jo can you post and pin at 21:50? @sam can you confirm final preflight? :thumbsup:

Irene Ramos: FINAL INTERNAL BLURB:
```
Redwood Inference v2.3.1 rollout (22:00-23:30 UTC)
- What: Serving runtime + routing update, model pin to redwood-model/v2.3.1
- Canary: 20% (15m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100%
- Impact: brief 0-2m reconnects possible for long-lived sessions (>10k tokens)
- Rollback: pin traffic back to redwood-model/v2.2.9 and revert runtime config; ops will execute rollback playbook if regressions detected
- Links: release notes: https://go.redwood.ai/releases/v2.3.1 | canary playbook: https://go.redwood.ai/playbooks/canary-deploy
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: start=2025-03-15T22:00:00Z, target=redwood-model/v2.3.1, id=deploy-20250315-1826

Sam O'Neill: Preflight ✅. DB migrations: none. Backups: taken. Dashboards and alert thresholds set. On-call rotation set: deepak -> rina -> sam.

Deepak Patel: One more ask — add a short rollback impact note: rollback to v2.2.9 will restore previous behavior but may increase token-cost by ~3% (so finance is aware).

Irene Ramos: Added rollback cost note. If no objections by 20:00 UTC I'll send the internal announcement and @jo will post+pin at 21:50 UTC. Thanks everyone.

Jo Kim: I'll handle posting. Will DM channel when live and pin.

Ellie Torres: Support thread ready. I'll paste canned replies after Jo posts so CS has copy.

Irene Ramos: Great — locking this. No objections recorded by 20:00 UTC => proceed to post. :white_check_mark:
